steps.instruction: Add a new variant { kind: "clear" } to the Command union. It has no other fields. Do not change Todo or nextId.
steps.interfaceChange: export type Command = { kind: "add"; title: string; due?: string; } | { kind: "complete"; id: number; } | { kind: "list"; } | { kind: "clear"; };

steps.instruction:
Add a 'clear' command that removes completed todos. A todo counts as completed when its `done` field is true (the request says 'completed', and `done` is the only completion field on Todo). The types unit is adding the variant { kind: "clear" } to Command in parallel with you, so Command will be: {kind:'add';title;due?} | {kind:'complete';id} | {kind:'list'} | {kind:'clear'}.
1. Export `clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[]`. It returns a new array holding only the todos with done === false, in their original order. It must not change the input array or any todo in it, and it must not renumber ids.
2. parseArgs(["clear"]) returns { kind: "clear" }.
3. run(path, { kind: "clear" }) loads the todos from path, applies clear, saves the result back to path, and returns the text `Cleared N completed todo(s).` where N is how many todos were removed (e.g. `Cleared 0 completed todo(s).`).
Keep all existing behaviour unchanged.
steps.interfaceChange: export declare function clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[];

input.reason: Add a 'clear' variant to Command in types. In commands, add a pure clear() function, parse 'clear', and handle it in run(). I read 'completed' as the existing `done` field, because Todo has no `completed` field.
